atm.event.banks_kre_spy_20.family_decision: PASS at factor-screening level because F-HIGHBETA satisfied every preregistered ADMIT_FOR_ROBUSTNESS gate. F-HIGHBETA CAGR 14.392126% exceeded V11 14.345615%, Sharpe 1.494292 exceeded matched control 1.464578, MDD 8.521421% <=12%, 4/7 folds matched or beat the matched control, worst-fold Sharpe 0.454167 >0, and constraints held. It did NOT satisfy STRONG_INCREMENTAL because CAGR improvement was <1.0 percentage point and Sharpe remained below V11. F-INDUTIL and F-BANKS failed only the CAGR>V11 gate despite beating matched controls on several dimensions. No horizon, retention fraction, stale rule, band, factor direction, or combination may be changed within this family.

atm.event.biotech_xbi_xlv_20.family_decision: FAIL / NO_CANDIDATE_ADMITTED. F-GROWTHBOND raised CAGR to 15.118864% but failed matched-control Sharpe, fold-comparison and MDD gates (MDD 19.324619%). F-TRANSPORT also failed. The event-only 100% completion architecture is therefore not admitted in this family. No gross-target rescue, horizon/stale/band change, or candidate retuning is allowed.
